requirements.title: Accounting/Ledger integration
requirements.summary: Export minimized financial facts with reconciliation; exclude diagnoses, prescriptions and clinical notes by default. Acceptance: Verify the actual Ledger ingestion contract and approve financial field mapping, currencies, source IDs and reconciliation responsibility. Export minimized approved financial facts only; diagnoses, prescriptions, patient notes and unnecessary identifiers are excluded by default. Use authenticated versioned idempotent exchange with explicit pending/rejected/reconciled state; no direct writes into Ledger tables or reuse of its sessions/secrets.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M8-003 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Inventory and consumables integration

Map only authorized stock/usage facts and explicit source documents; this task cannot infer medication substitution or dispensing authority. Keep stock owner as authoritative and reconcile accepted/rejected/pending usage; no cross-app imports or direct shared database writes.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M8-004 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Team/employment reference integration
requirements.summary: Link approved staff references without granting payroll/HR users access to patient records. Acceptance: Approve staff-reference fields and the actual owning employment/team capability; employment identity is distinct from Doctor membership. requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M8-005 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Notification/mail capability integration
